pairs.subject: quality-gates
pairs.evidence: crates/shadowrunr-reconcile/src/verify.rs:220 When no character directory resolves (characters_root unset, no character id on the runs, or the directory missing), the hunk-applies-to-the-current-file check is skipped silently: the proposal is kept with no dropped entry and no summary note, so a diff the gate could not verify reads exactly like one it verified.

techniques.evidence: crates/shadowrunr-reconcile/src/verify.rs:220 The gate can't see the file here, which is a hole in its own view, and it reads as compliance. The skip isn't announced or counted. lib.rs:223-228 returns None in several cases.

crates/shadowrunr-reconcile/src/synth.rs:360 The brief given to the Reconciler is a hand-written projection of the diff policy and states only the path rule. verify.rs also refuses deletions (l.200), renames (l.213), creating a file that already exists (l.224) and hunk-less diffs, and the brief never mentions them. The surface understates what blocks.

crates/shadowrunr-reconcile/src/verify.rs:163 A diff the parser cannot read is refused, not passed. Any stray line naming constitution.md is also refused (l.178-179), so rename-form evasions fail too.
crates/shadowrunr-reconcile/src/verify.rs:191 If zero file patches parse, that is an error, not an empty pass. Tests feed known-bad inputs (l.262-276, including "just prose").

crates/shadowrunr-reconcile/src/verify.rs:30 The model writes its own evidence refs. Each ref is resolved against the real transcripts, never taken on the model's word, and every unresolved ref is recorded as dropped.

crates/shadowrunr-reconcile/src/verify.rs:203 Uses an allowlist (bible.md, tones/*.md) rather than a denylist, after the path is normalised (l.72-86), and refuses renames (l.211). Renaming or path-escaping can't reach the immutable file.
crates/shadowrunr-reconcile/src/verify.rs:236 When the file is readable, each hunk's old side is matched against the file's current content, not only against the diff text.
crates/shadowrunr-reconcile/src/verify.rs:205 The refusal names the permitted targets, which are inside the same package.

crates/shadowrunr-reconcile/src/verify.rs:196 The repairer (the Reconciler LLM improving the character) cannot write to the immutable constitution. The freeze is enforced by the verifier, not just requested in the prompt.
crates/shadowrunr-reconcile/src/lib.rs:400 A rejected diff actually removes the option (continue at l.401) and records the reason. The finding does more than print.
